All weapon sound auditions

Sean selected T11 — Water gush for Tony and S1 — Suction pop for Sean. All 17 choices remain here for Tony to compare.

This single file contains every sound, including all five-shot demos. Save or share the HTML file itself; no internet connection or companion folder is needed. Open it in a web browser and press any player. Nothing plays automatically.

About these sounds

Original project-generated synthesis, not recordings of real water or rubber. No third-party samples or attribution obligations. Audio is embedded without re-encoding: mono, 44.1 kHz, 16-bit PCM WAV.

Single shots target −24 dBFS RMS, with a −9 dBFS peak ceiling. This does not guarantee equal perceived loudness. Five-shot demos use 160 ms spacing for Tony and 240 ms for Sean; these are audition timing examples.
